comment: Lists Nulavio switches on in uBlock Origin for a new profile, on top of uBlock Origin's own defaults: the set Helium 0.21.2.1 switches on (read from a fresh profile on 2026-11-11), without Helium's own two lists. A default only: the person's later choice in uBlock Origin's dashboard is never overwritten. ublock-origin/assets.json is uBlock Origin's list registry, copied unchanged from the pinned package (GPL-3.0, ublock-origin/LICENSE.txt); refresh it with scripts/upstream/refresh_extensions_lock.py --registry. changed_on is the day default_on, or the registry it is applied to, was last changed (set it by hand with default_on; --registry sets it when the registry is another): the build writes it into the notice that goes out with the modified copy. When this stops working: docs/security/dependency-updates.md, "uBlock Origin's default lists".
